name: Pink Haze
source:
Main character wakes up from fever symptoms in the middle of the night. He makes a call to the nearby clinic in search of consultation, but doctor unexpectedly suggests coming over. What will happen at this six tatami space at night?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角半夜因发烧症状醒来。他打电话给附近的诊所寻求咨询，医生却出人意料地建议亲自上门。夜晚，在这间六叠大小的房间里究竟会发生什么？

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
